name: Italian Chickpea Salad with Artichoke, Carrot, Celery & Bell Pepper
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
Drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Place oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, trim, and small dice carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice celery. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell pepper. Add to the bowl.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Drain and mince artichokes. Add to the bowl, along with the chickpeas, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chickpea salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
author: Mealime
